```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, results = "asis")
source(file.path(pipeline_folder, "workflow", "scripts", "R", "report_helpers.R"), local = knitr::knit_global())
report_start("assemble")

as_dir <- function(...) p("results", "assemble", ...)
assembler <- ctx$config$assembler %||% "metaspades"
assemblies <- ctx$assemblies

contigs <- setNames(map(assemblies, function(a) {
  file <- assembly_fasta(a)
  if (file.exists(file)) fasta_table(file) else NULL
}), assemblies)
contigs <- compact(contigs)

assembly_stats <- map_dfr(names(contigs), function(a) {
  table <- contigs[[a]]
  bind_cols(tibble(assembly_id = a, gc_pct = 100 * sum(as.numeric(table$gc)) / sum(as.numeric(table$length))), length_stats(table$length))
})

# Mapping back: bowtie2 writes its summary to the log of each mapping
mapping <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(assembly_members())), function(i) {
  row <- assembly_members()[i, ]
  file <- as_dir("bowtie2", paste0(row$assembly_id, ".", row$library, ".log"))
  if (!file.exists(file)) return(NULL)
  lines <- readLines(file, warn = FALSE)
  rate <- grep("overall alignment rate", lines, value = TRUE)
  pairs <- grep("reads; of these:", lines, value = TRUE)
  concordant <- grep("aligned concordantly exactly 1 time|aligned concordantly >1 times", lines[seq_len(min(20, length(lines)))], value = TRUE)
  tibble(
    assembly_id = row$assembly_id,
    library = row$library,
    pairs = if (length(pairs)) as.numeric(sub(" reads.*", "", trimws(pairs[[1]]))) else NA_real_,
    overall_pct = if (length(rate)) as.numeric(sub("%.*", "", rate[[1]])) else NA_real_
  )
})

count_bins <- function(binner, assembly) {
  folder <- as_dir(binner, assembly)
  if (!dir.exists(folder)) return(NA_integer_)
  length(list.files(folder, pattern = "\\.fa(\\.gz)?$"))
}
binning <- map_dfr(assemblies, function(a) {
  refined_file <- as_dir("magscot", a, "magscot.refined.contig_to_bin.out")
  refined <- if (file.exists(refined_file)) read_table_quiet(refined_file) else NULL
  bp <- if (!is.null(refined) && a %in% names(contigs)) {
    sum(as.numeric(contigs[[a]]$length[contigs[[a]]$contig %in% refined$contig]))
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }
  tibble(
    assembly_id = a,
    metabat2 = count_bins("metabat2", a),
    maxbin2 = count_bins("maxbin2", a),
    concoct = count_bins("concoct", a),
    magscot = if (is.null(refined)) NA_integer_ else n_distinct(refined$binnew),
    binned_bp = bp,
    binned_pct = if (a %in% names(contigs)) 100 * bp / sum(as.numeric(contigs[[a]]$length)) else NA_real_
  )
})

magscot_bins <- map_dfr(assemblies, function(a) {
  file <- as_dir("magscot", a, "magscot.refined.out")
  if (!file.exists(file)) return(NULL)
  mutate(read_table_quiet(file), assembly_id = a)
})

# dRep keeps its tables in an archive
drep_tables <- list()
archive <- as_dir("drep", "data_tables.tar.gz")
if (file.exists(archive)) {
  folder <- tempfile("drep")
  dir.create(folder)
  untar(archive, exdir = folder)
  for (name in c("genomeInformation", "Cdb", "Wdb", "Widb")) {
    file <- file.path(folder, "data_tables", paste0(name, ".csv"))
    if (file.exists(file)) drep_tables[[name]] <- read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  }
  unlink(folder, recursive = TRUE)
}
n_before <- length(list.files(as_dir("drep", "separated_bins"), pattern = "\\.fa"))
n_after <- length(list.files(as_dir("drep", "dereplicated_genomes"), pattern = "\\.fa"))
catalogue_fai <- as_dir("drep", "dereplicated_genomes.fa.gz.fai")
catalogue <- if (file.exists(catalogue_fai)) read.delim(catalogue_fai, header = FALSE, quote = "", comment.char = "")[[2]] else NULL
```

```{r brief}
section("Results in brief", {
  if (nrow(assembly_stats) == 0) {
    no_output("the assembler", paste0("results/assemble/", assembler, "/"))
  } else {
    para(
      "**", nrow(assembly_stats), " assemblies** with ", assembler, " hold ", fmt_int(sum(assembly_stats$contigs)), " contigs and ",
      fmt_bp(sum(assembly_stats$total_bp)), " in total. N50 ranges from ", fmt_int(min(assembly_stats$N50)), " to ", fmt_int(max(assembly_stats$N50)), " bp, and the longest contig has ",
      fmt_int(max(assembly_stats$longest)), " bp."
    )
    sentences <- c(
      if (nrow(mapping) > 0) {
        paste0("Between ", fmt_pct(min(mapping$overall_pct, na.rm = TRUE)), " and ", fmt_pct(max(mapping$overall_pct, na.rm = TRUE)),
               " of the reads map back to their assemblies. The rest is in genomes that could not be assembled, or in very short contigs.")
      },
      if (any(!is.na(binning$magscot))) {
        paste0("MAGScoT refined the bins of the three binners to ", plural(sum(binning$magscot, na.rm = TRUE), "bin"), " over all assemblies.")
      },
      if (n_after > 0) {
        paste0("dRep reduced ", plural(n_before, "bin"), " to **", plural(n_after, "representative genome"), "**",
               if (!is.null(catalogue)) paste0(", which form a catalogue of ", fmt_int(length(catalogue)), " contigs and ", fmt_bp(sum(as.numeric(catalogue)))) else "", ".")
      }
    )
    bullets(sentences)
    para("Binning and dereplication depend on depth: a small test data set gives few bins, and says little about the full data.")
  }
})
```

```{r assembly}
section("Assembly", {
  if (nrow(assembly_stats) == 0) {
    no_output("the assembler", paste0("results/assemble/", assembler, "/"))
  } else {
    members <- assembly_members() %>% count(assembly_id, name = "libraries")
    table <- left_join(assembly_stats, members, by = "assembly_id")
    para("**N50** is the length such that contigs of at least this length hold half of the assembly, and **L50** is the number of those contigs. Both describe ",
         "contiguity and not correctness. Contigs shorter than the assembler's minimum length aren't in the assembly.")
    show_table(
      table %>% transmute(
        Assembly = assembly_id, Libraries = fmt_int(libraries), Contigs = fmt_int(contigs), Length = fmt_bp(total_bp), Longest = fmt_int(longest), N50 = fmt_int(N50),
        L50 = fmt_int(L50), N90 = fmt_int(N90), `>= 5 kb` = fmt_int(contigs_ge_5kb), `>= 10 kb` = fmt_int(contigs_ge_10kb), GC = fmt_pct(gc_pct)
      ),
      "Assembly statistics",
      "assembly_statistics",
      export = table,
      max_rows = 60
    )
    curves <- map_dfr(names(contigs), function(a) {
      lengths <- sort(contigs[[a]]$length, decreasing = TRUE)
      keep <- unique(round(seq(1, length(lengths), length.out = min(length(lengths), 500))))
      tibble(assembly_id = a, share = 100 * cumsum(as.numeric(lengths))[keep] / sum(as.numeric(lengths)), length = lengths[keep])
    })
    write_tsv(curves, file.path(ctx$tables, "nx_curves.tsv"))
    show_figure(
      ggplot(curves, aes(share, length, group = assembly_id, colour = assembly_id)) +
        geom_line(linewidth = 0.4) +
        geom_vline(xintercept = 50, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
        scale_y_log10() +
        scale_colour_manual(values = rep_len(PALETTE, n_distinct(curves$assembly_id)), guide = if (length(contigs) > 12) "none" else guide_legend(ncol = 4), name = NULL) +
        labs(x = "Share of the assembly (%)", y = "Contig length (bp, logarithmic scale)") +
        theme_report(),
      "nx_curves",
      "Nx curves: a contig of length y and longer ones together hold x% of the assembly. At the dashed line, y is the N50. A curve further up means a more contiguous assembly."
    )
    lengths <- map_dfr(names(contigs), ~ tibble(assembly_id = .x, length = contigs[[.x]]$length))
    show_figure(
      ggplot(lengths, aes(length, fill = assembly_id)) +
        geom_histogram(bins = 40, position = "identity", alpha = 0.6) +
        scale_x_log10() +
        scale_fill_manual(values = rep_len(PALETTE, length(contigs)), guide = if (length(contigs) > 12) "none" else guide_legend(ncol = 4), name = NULL) +
        labs(x = "Contig length (bp, logarithmic scale)", y = "Contigs") +
        theme_report(),
      "contig_lengths",
      "Distribution of contig lengths per assembly.",
      height = 2.8
    )
  }
})
```

```{r mapping}
section("Reads mapped back to the assemblies", {
  if (nrow(mapping) == 0) {
    no_output("Bowtie2", "results/assemble/bowtie2/")
  } else {
    para("This is the best single number for how much of the sequenced community an assembly represents. A low rate means that most reads are from ",
         "genomes with too little coverage to be assembled. Compare this with the coverage from Nonpareil in the read_annotate report.")
    show_table(
      mapping %>% transmute(Assembly = assembly_id, Library = library, `Read pairs` = fmt_int(pairs), Mapped = fmt_pct(overall_pct, 2)),
      "Overall alignment rate per library and assembly, from Bowtie2",
      "mapping_rates",
      export = mapping,
      max_rows = 60
    )
    show_figure(
      mapping %>%
        mutate(library = factor(library, levels = rev(libraries()))) %>%
        ggplot(aes(overall_pct, library)) +
        geom_col(fill = PALETTE[[1]]) +
        facet_wrap(~assembly_id) +
        labs(x = "Reads mapped back (%)", y = NULL) +
        theme_report() +
        library_axis(n_distinct(mapping$library)),
      "mapping_rates",
      "Share of reads mapped back to each assembly.",
      height = rows_height(n_distinct(mapping$library))
    )
  }
})
```

```{r binning}
section("Binning and refinement", {
  if (all(is.na(binning$metabat2) & is.na(binning$maxbin2) & is.na(binning$concoct))) {
    no_output("the binners", "results/assemble/")
  } else {
    para("Three binners group contigs into bins by their coverage and composition. MAGScoT then scores their bins with single-copy marker genes and builds a refined ",
         "set. The share **binned** is the share of the assembly's bases in the refined bins.")
    show_table(
      binning %>% transmute(
        Assembly = assembly_id, MetaBAT2 = fmt_int(metabat2), MaxBin2 = fmt_int(maxbin2), CONCOCT = fmt_int(concoct), MAGScoT = fmt_int(magscot),
        `Binned length` = fmt_bp(binned_bp), Binned = fmt_pct(binned_pct)
      ),
      "Bins per binner, and after refinement",
      "bins_per_assembly",
      export = binning,
      max_rows = 60
    )
    long <- binning %>%
      select(assembly_id, MetaBAT2 = metabat2, MaxBin2 = maxbin2, CONCOCT = concoct, MAGScoT = magscot) %>%
      pivot_longer(-assembly_id, names_to = "binner", values_to = "bins")
    show_figure(
      ggplot(long, aes(bins, assembly_id, fill = binner)) +
        geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(PALETTE[1:4], c("MetaBAT2", "MaxBin2", "CONCOCT", "MAGScoT")), name = NULL) +
        labs(x = "Bins", y = NULL) +
        theme_report(),
      "bins_per_binner",
      "Bins per binner and assembly.",
      height = rows_height(length(assemblies), 0.5, 1.2)
    )
  }
  if (nrow(magscot_bins) > 0) {
    bins <- magscot_bins %>%
      transmute(assembly_id, bin = bin, source = bintool, marker_set = set, completeness = 100 * Completeness, contamination = 100 * Contamination,
                contigs = n_contigs, score = score)
    show_table(
      bins %>% arrange(desc(score)) %>% transmute(
        Assembly = assembly_id, Bin = bin, From = source, `Marker set` = marker_set,
        Completeness = fmt_pct(completeness), Contamination = fmt_pct(contamination), Contigs = fmt_int(contigs)
      ),
      "Refined bins, as MAGScoT scored them with its own marker genes",
      "refined_bins",
      export = bins,
      max_rows = 25,
      note = "These are MAGScoT's estimates, used to choose bins. CheckM2 in the mag_annotate report is the estimate to publish."
    )
    show_figure(
      ggplot(bins, aes(contamination, completeness, colour = source)) +
        geom_point(size = 1.6, alpha = 0.8) +
        scale_colour_manual(values = rep_len(PALETTE, n_distinct(bins$source)), name = NULL) +
        labs(x = "Contamination (%)", y = "Completeness (%)") +
        theme_report(),
      "refined_bins_quality",
      "Completeness and contamination of the refined bins, colored by the binner they came from.",
      height = 3.2
    )
  }
})
```

```{r drep}
section("Dereplication and the genome catalogue", {
  if (n_after == 0) {
    no_output("dRep", "results/assemble/drep/dereplicated_genomes/")
  } else {
    settings <- ctx$params$assemble$drep
    para(
      "dRep groups similar bins of all assemblies and keeps the best of each group, so that the next modules work on a non-redundant catalogue. **",
      plural(n_before, "bin"), "** went in, and **", plural(n_after, "representative genome"), "** came out. The thresholds were: ", settings$P_ani %||% "?",
      " ANI for primary clusters, ", settings$S_ani %||% "?", " ANI for secondary clusters, at least ", settings$completeness %||% "?",
      "% completeness and at most ", settings$contamination %||% "?", "% contamination."
    )
    if (!is.null(catalogue)) {
      stats <- length_stats(catalogue)
      show_table(
        stats %>% transmute(Contigs = fmt_int(contigs), Length = fmt_bp(total_bp), Longest = fmt_int(longest), N50 = fmt_int(N50), L50 = fmt_int(L50), N90 = fmt_int(N90)),
        "The genome catalogue, all genomes together",
        "catalogue",
        export = stats
      )
    }
    if (!is.null(drep_tables$genomeInformation)) {
      info <- drep_tables$genomeInformation
      winners <- if (!is.null(drep_tables$Wdb)) drep_tables$Wdb$genome else character(0)
      clusters <- drep_tables$Cdb
      table <- info %>%
        mutate(representative = genome %in% winners)
      if (!is.null(clusters)) table <- left_join(table, select(clusters, genome, secondary_cluster), by = "genome")
      # With --ignoreGenomeQuality, dRep has no quality values
      if (!"secondary_cluster" %in% names(table)) table$secondary_cluster <- NA_character_
      if (!"completeness" %in% names(table)) table$completeness <- NA_real_
      if (!"contamination" %in% names(table)) table$contamination <- NA_real_
      show_table(
        table %>% arrange(desc(representative), desc(length)) %>% transmute(
          Genome = genome, Cluster = secondary_cluster,
          Representative = ifelse(representative, "yes", ""), Length = fmt_bp(length), N50 = fmt_int(N50),
          Completeness = fmt_num(completeness), Contamination = fmt_num(contamination)
        ),
        "All bins in dRep, with their clusters. Quality values are those known to dRep, and are missing if its quality check was skipped",
        "drep_genomes",
        export = table,
        max_rows = 30
      )
    }
  }
})
```

```{r methods}
section("Methods text", {
  para("You can use or adapt this text for a paper. It describes what the rules of this module did, with the settings of this project.")
  s <- ctx$params$assemble
  tool_text <- if (assembler == "megahit") {
    paste0(tv("MEGAHIT"), " (k-mers ", s$megahit$kmin %||% "?", " to ", s$megahit$kmax %||% "?", " in steps of ", s$megahit$kstep %||% "?", ", minimum contig length ", s$megahit$min_contig_len %||% "?", " bp)")
  } else if (assembler == "metaspades") {
    paste0(tv("metaSPAdes"), " (k-mers ", s$metaspades$kmer_size %||% "?", ", options `", trimws(s$metaspades$additional_options %||% ""), "`)")
  } else {
    paste0("assemblies provided by the user (", assembler, ")")
  }
  para(
    "> Clean reads were assembled per sample or co-assembled as set in the sample sheet with ", tool_text, ". Reads were mapped back to the assemblies with ", tv("Bowtie2"),
    ", and alignments were sorted with ", tv("SAMtools"), ". Contigs were binned with ", tv("MetaBAT2"), ", ", tv("MaxBin2"), " and ", tv("CONCOCT"), ". Bins were refined with MAGScoT, using marker genes that ",
    tv("Prodigal"), " and ", tv("HMMER"), " found (score threshold ", s$magscot$threshold %||% "?", "). Refined bins of all assemblies were dereplicated with ", tv("dRep"), " (primary ANI ", s$drep$P_ani %||% "?", ", secondary ANI ",
    s$drep$S_ani %||% "?", ", minimum completeness ", s$drep$completeness %||% "?", "%, maximum contamination ", s$drep$contamination %||% "?", "%)."
  )
})
```
